name: Doki Heika Banzai!
summary: "This is the project I've worked on for the last couple weeks. It's a comedy set in WW2 Imperial Japan and it's pretty short!I can't really reveal much of the plot without giving away too much, but I can tell you that the protagonist and the four girls are going to war in this one and whacky adventures are ensured! The mod is a bit NSFW."
